Title: Ongoing tournament rule change playtest: final seating

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
To make it more official, there is an ongoing playtest of a rule change regarding seating in the final. This playtest is supported by the National Coordinators of those countries:  Spain France United Kingdom United States Ireland Netherlands  as well as those countries which were willing to give a try, if possible:  Australia South Africa Singapore Hungary Malaysia Germany Belarus  Tournaments using the new rule are sanctioned as usual.

For more details, please contact your National Coordinator.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
